• Synonym: Hemipimelodus daugueti
  • IUCN Red List: Not Evaluated
Asia: Mekong basin. Large rivers of South East Asia. Type locality: Phnompenh et Snoctrou, au seuil du Grand Lac. Type(s): at Inst. Océanogr. Indochine, Nhatrang, Viet Nam.

Etymology: the genus name Cryptarius comes from kryptos, hidden or secret, i.e. a cryptic Arius, referring to its unique combination of characters having been ignored for such a long time. The specific name daugueti honours Paul Dauguet (1883-?), merchant seaman and commander of le Lanessan, from which the type was collected.

Kailola (2004: 135) tentatively assigned this species to Cryptarius.
